messages:
Lina (CS): Heads up finance — MavenGrid (acct MAV-402) emailed about April invoice INV-2026-04-7710. They say a promo (NEWCUSTOMER25) should have applied only to the first month but the system applied it across the whole billing period after they downgraded mid-cycle. They want a corrected credit + confirmation on tax treatment.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-04-7710 generated 2026-04-06 10:02 UTC. Lines: RESERVED-XL x1 (4 GPUs) 2026-04-01 - 2026-04-30 $7,200.00; Usage $125.00; Promo NEWCUSTOMER25 -25% (applied on 2026-04-01) ; Total due $5,375.00.

Tom (BillingOps): Can you confirm the subscription change date and what the promo rules are on this promo? Some promos are one-month only, some are first-bill only.

Lina (CS): Downgrade to RESERVED-L (3 GPUs) effective 2026-04-09. Promo code NEWCUSTOMER25 was added 2026-04-01 via sales. Sales note: "25% off first month only". Customer included the sales email.

Sam (Finance): If sales intended it to be only first month, system bug re-applied percentage after proration rules. I'm OK to approve a manual correction up to $2,000. Anything higher needs manager sign-off. Also legal should weigh in on tax memo for invoice amendment.

Tom (BillingOps): I ran the proration calc. Output: 
```
Account: MAV-402
Change date: 2026-04-09 07:40 UTC
Original reserved XL monthly: $7,200.00
New reserved L monthly: $5,400.00
Days on XL: 8 days -> (8/30)*7200 = 1920.00
Days on L: 22 days -> (22/30)*5400 = 3960.00
Prorated reserved total = 5880.00
Original reserved if unchanged = 7200.00
Delta reserved = 7200 - 5880 = 1320.00
Promo application: NEWCUSTOMER25 should have applied to first bill only. System applied 25% to entire reserved amount -> over-discount = (prorated reserved * 0.25) - (first-bill cap 0.25*7200) ??? (we need to compute corrective credit)
Compute expected discount for first bill: 0.25 * 7200 = 1800.00
System discount applied: 0.25 * 5880.00 = 1470.00
Net difference (system under-discount vs intended) = 1800 - 1470 = 330.00 owed to customer? Wait: sales said first month only so customer should have gotten 1800 on first bill; system gave 1470 across whole prorated month, which is less overall discount on reserved, but they claim it applied beyond first month? Hmm re-check logs.
```
Tom (BillingOps): (followup) My earlier note was confusing — ledger shows system applied promo to both reserved and usage as a recurring promo for April cycle, and again flagged on May preliminary invoice preview. That caused duplicated credit on usage line of $410.00 and an extra reserved discount carryover of $220.00. Net over-credit to customer = 630.00 (company liability). See debug tag: PR-2026-04-62.

Lina (CS): Customer says they didn't want a recurring discount; they want us to remove the extra then apply the correct first-bill discount and issue any refund if they were overcharged/undercredited.

Sam (Finance): Given numbers, total corrective credit to reconcile April invoice = $630.00. I approve issuing credit memo up to $2k. Tom, please add a note that this is corrective due to promo configuration error and flag for dev to prevent recurrence. Eve (Legal), any concerns on invoice amendment vs replacement?

Eve (Legal): If we adjust the invoice with a credit memo and do not reissue a replacement invoice, we should include an explanatory note on the customer-facing statement that clarifies the credit reason. Tax treatment: small credits under $1k can be handled as adjustments on the same invoice in our jurisdiction, but confirm with local tax team if the customer's billing address is outside US. For now OK to proceed with credit memo; tag tax-team for cross-border check.

Tom (BillingOps): Creating credit memo now. Journal entry: 
```
CreditMemo: CR-2026-04-062
Customer: MAV-402 (MavenGrid)
Amount: -630.00 USD
AppliedTo: INV-2026-04-7710
Reason: Promo misconfiguration; duplicate recurring discount on usage & reserved. (debug PR-2026-04-62)
CreatedBy: Tom (BillingOps)
```
Applied on 2026-04-06 16:45 UTC.

billing-bot: CreditMemo CR-2026-04-062 created and applied to INV-2026-04-7710 on 2026-04-06 16:45 UTC. New balance: $4,745.00.

Lina (CS): I'll send MavenGrid a short note summarizing the fix + attach CR-2026-04-062 and the sales email. Also apologize for the confusion — offer a one-time usage credit of $200 as goodwill if they'd like. Thoughts?

Sam (Finance): Goodwill add-on of $200 is fine to offer; please log as discretionary credit (separate memo) and get customer acceptance. If they accept, keep it off the ledger as a separate memo CR-2026-04-063 and mark "customer-approved".

Tom (BillingOps): Added ledger note and flagged developer ticket to prevent recurring promo carryover (ENG-PR-1244). Marking finance-approved. Closing thread.
